cost_accounting.rates_source: Current published token-credit rates verified 2026-10-16 at https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/pricing#token-rates (GPT-6.1 Sol: 50/2.5/250 credits; GPT-6 Luna: 2.5/0.25/12.5). These price purchased/credit usage; included subscription allowance is not a monetary cost and per-run subscription debit is not exposed by harness.
